notes.title: Wordlike v0.14: New Shop and Blanks, Balls, and Buffs
notes.content:
🎉 Wordlike v0.14 is here! 🎉

⭐ New Features

2 New Events:

🪆 Faceless Doll: Take it if you're ready to play exclusively Blanks, but don't break your promise...
✍️ Pool Ball Contract: Sign it, and your Pool Ball packs will always contain your most played word length.


5 New Knick-Knacks:

💳 Credit Card: Gains +2 points for every dollar you spend.
👛 Purse: +1 multiplier for every dollar you have.
⌨️ Blank Keyboard: x3 multiplier for a word that's all blanks.
🏞️ Unused Film: +5 multiplier for every used blank.
🪄 Magic Wand: Permanently gain a blank when you make an 8-letter word.



✅ Improvements

New Shop: Now features 3 slots for Knick-Knacks or Stickers and 2 slots for packs.
Pool Ball Buffs: All levels have been buffed, and limits are removed.
Monkey's Paw Buffed: Offers better utility.
Magic 8 Ball Buffed: No risk of downgrading levels.
Piggy Bank Buffed: Choose specific Knick-Knacks or Stickers to sell and get 4x their sell value.
Tile Stew Buffed: Now grants more points.
Wheel Buffed: Bankruptcy has been removed.
Piano Nerfed: Balancing changes applied.
Disabled Buttons: Now appear more obvious.


🐞 Bug Fixes

Joker Fix: Now copies Easel properly.
Easel and Funnel Fix: Synergize correctly now.
Tooltip Cutoff Fixed: Tooltips are no longer cut off.
Reject Fix: Works on Re-roll Contract as intended.
Board 4 Fix: No longer shows empty Knick-Knack packs.
Promise Fix: Can now be copied by the Joker.
Printer Fix: Quickly pressing "Continue" doesn’t break the UI.
Blue Pill Fix: Doesn’t break the Board anymore.
The Mask Fix: Text is now displayed correctly.

notes.title: Wordlike v0.13: Tile Packs, Traits, and Tactical Boards!
notes.content:
🎉 Wordlike v0.13 is here! 🎉

⭐ New Features

3 New Events:

Gift Exchange: Bring a Knick-Knack to share and receive a rarer one in return.
Piggy Bank: Sell all of your Knick-Knacks and get triple their sell value.
Tile Stew: Stir up your tiles; they’ll all get a random new letter and gain 2 points.

4 New Contracts
Tile Packs: Choose a selection of 4 exquisite tiles. 💠
Knick-Knack Traits: Knick-Knacks now have a chance to be Digital, Antique, Shiny, or Radioactive, each offering a unique boost. ☢️✨


✅ Improvements

New Board Layout: Every board is now 4x4, with 4 boards to explore.
Event Indicators: Boards now display icons indicating each event, helping you strategize.
Hover Information: Hover over a board space for more detailed information.
No Duplicate Pool Balls: Pool balls won’t appear as duplicates in packs anymore.


🐞 Bug Fixes

Shop Offerings: Sticker packs are now exclusively available in the shop.
Chili Button: The Chili button can no longer be repeatedly pressed.
Boss Debuff Fix: Losing to the “Consonants don’t score” boss no longer carries the debuff into your next run.
Selling Funnel Adjustment: The effect of Selling Funnel is now removed immediately upon sale, rather than taking a turn.
Tile Copy Fix: A copied tile no longer inherits the point boost from its original.

notes.title: Wordlike v0.12: Sticker Bonanza
notes.content:
🎉 Wordlike v0.12 is here! 🎉

⭐ New Features

3 New Events:
  
  Spin the Wheel: Risk losing all of your Knick-Knicks for a chance at a free Exceptional one.
  Sticker Printer: Enjoy a few stickers on the house.
  Promise: Get a lot of multiplier if you keep your promise, but expect misfortune if you break it...
  
16 New Stickers: Log, Crown, Chalk, Ring, Jacket, Bust, Pillow, Screw, Sword, Stamp, Compass, Pool Cue, Mushroom, Eraser, Stamp, Coin, and an updated Chili.
Knick-Knack Packs: Purchase a case of Knick-Knicks for a broader selection.
Sticker Sheets: Purchase a sheet of stickers and choose three of your favorites!


✅ Improvements

More Shop Opportunities: You’ll now always visit the Shop after beating a level, providing more chances to optimize your build.
Permanent Internet Slang: Slang words are playable without the Mask, though the Mask still boosts your multiplier for slang.
Shop Re-Roll: Pay a few bucks to refresh the Shop inventory.
Additional “?” Space: Every board now includes an extra “?” space.
Magic Eight-Ball Buff: Now targets your most played word length, upgrading it by five levels if you’re lucky (or resetting it to level 1 if you’re not).

notes.title: Wordlike v0.11: The Event Horizon
notes.content:
🎉 Wordlike v0.11 is here! 🎉

⭐ New Events

Magic 8 Ball Event: Take a chance to upgrade one of your word lengths by multiple levels... or risk it being reset back to level 1.
Bank Contract Event: Sign a lucrative contract to earn more money each turn, but be prepared to pay the cost.
Red Pill, Blue Pill Event: Play it safe and reset the board, or take a bold risk and see how deep the rabbit hole goes.


✅ Improvements

Events are now integrated into the game board via question marks, adjusting frequency of existing shop and boss encounters.

notes.title: Wordlike v0.10: Tile Enhancement Takeover
notes.content:
🎉 Wordlike v0.10 is here! 🎉

⭐ Features

Leather Tiles: Gains points the more you use it.
Gold Tiles: Earn some $ every time you play it.
Velvet Tiles: Adjacent tiles to this one gain more points.
Blackboard Tiles: Converts the tile into a blank.
Rust Tiles: Provides a x2 multiplier, but the tile is destroyed if not used.
Diamond Tiles: Gives a higher multiplier, but the letter on the tile changes with every draw.


✅ Improvements

Consumables like Chili cannot be used on blanks and differentiate with Blackboard tiles
Crystal Ball expanded to handle new tile enhancements

notes.title: Wordlike v0.9: Blanks Button, Pool Case, and Crystal Ball
notes.content:
🎉 Wordlike v0.9 is here! 🎉 

 ⭐ Features      Blanks Button: Start each round with 4 blanks. No more discarding hands! Use your blanks wisely.    Pool Case: Choose pool balls from a case with multiple options to upgrade points and multipliers for various word lengths.    Crystal Ball: Discover the 'Exceptional' Knick Knack that randomly enhances a tile for every word played.      ✅ Improvements      Score and Text Animations: Tweaks to improve how scores and text animate in      🐞 Bug Fixes      Volume Controls: Music and sound effects volume now adjust correctly.
